warnings: ROOF-LEVEL FRAMING, ALL STRUCTURAL STEEL. Every member on this sheet is recorded with steel_section per spec §6a and none carries main_bar/stirrup. Sections come from the sheet's own หมายเหตุ block: จันทันเหล็ก C-100x50x20x2.3 มม. (4.06 กก./ม.), แปเหล็ก C-75x45x15x2.3 มม. @1.00 ม. (3.25 กก./ม.), อกไก่เหล็ก 2 C-125x50x20x3.2 มม. (6.13 กก./ม.), ตะเฆ่สันเหล็ก 2 C-100x50x20x2.3 มม. (4.06 กก./ม.), CS1 = ตั้งเหล็ก 2 C-150x75x25x3.2 มม. (8.27 กก./ม.), BS1 = คานเหล็ก 2 C-150x75x25x3.2 มม. (8.27 กก./ม.).

BS1 and CS1 are the SAME section (2 C-150x75x25x3.2, 8.27 กก./ม.) used two ways -- BS1 as a beam (คาน), CS1 as a post (ตั้ง). The mark, not the section, distinguishes them, so element_type is set from the mark.

TWO DISTINCT ROOF ZONES. Over the main block (grids 1-3) the sheet draws only a BS1 beam grillage with three CS1 props and no rafters or purlins at all. Over the right wing (grid 3 to grid 4 + 1.20 m) it draws a full hipped roof -- ridge, two hips, rafters and purlins. Whatever covers the main block is therefore NOT documented on this sheet; look for it on the roof sections (S-06 onward).

ROOF GEOMETRY READ FROM THE LINE WEIGHTS, and worth re-checking: the อกไก่ leader arrows onto the SHORT thick-dashed segment at the west end, so the ridge runs from grid 3 eastward only about 1.50 m, and the two 45-degree hips run from that point out to the north-east and south-east corners. The long thick dash-dot line continuing east on the same centre-line is then the central rafter of the east hip plane, not the ridge. The 45-degree hip slope and the ridge sitting exactly at mid-depth of the roof rectangle both confirm this reading.

The right-wing roof oversails 1.20 m on the north, east and south sides (1.20 printed at the top right and at the middle right); on the west it stops on grid 3 where it meets the main block. Overall framed rectangle 5.20 x 7.40 m.

จันทัน SPACING IS NOT PRINTED. The dimension chain along the bottom of the roof shows an even spacing that scales to about 1.50 m; recorded as 1.50 with spacing_scaled_not_printed. Only the แป spacing (@1.00 ม.) is printed.

The intermediate BS1 in the 1-2 bay between rows C and B, and the CS1 that props it, have NO locating dimension. REWRITTEN 2026-07-27 (recording a reversal): the first pass scaled its position as 'roughly 1.1 m below grid C'; a pixel-measured re-read puts it at approx 2.1 m below C -- essentially the C-B bay's MID-LINE. Both members stay flagged off_grid_member_no_printed_dimension because the drawing itself still prints nothing.

The circled 'ดูขยาย 1' at grid A-1 is captioned 'แสดงการยึดเสา ค.ส.ล.กับคานเหล็กและจันทัน' -- the sheet's own confirmation that the frame is HYBRID, RC columns below carrying a steel roof above. The enlargement itself is on S-15 (PNG 48): a 200x200x9 base plate on the column head with two Ø9 anchors 0.15 m deep, and the rafter cleated to BS1 with a 100x100x9 plate.
